events.description: A flat 2D textured banner is displayed on screen and then morphs/transforms into a 3D textured sphere.
events.clip_query: A flat rectangular map banner transforms into a 3D textured sphere

events.description: A blue wireframe surface mesh is written/drawn over the textured sphere to highlight its geometry.
events.clip_query: A blue grid mesh is drawn over a 3D sphere

events.description: The textured sphere and mesh fade out, replaced by a set of discrete 3D parametric slices (peels) of the sphere.
events.clip_query: The sphere is replaced by segmented vertical slices or peels

events.description: A subset of the sphere slices are highlighted in yellow and scaled slightly outward to emphasize them.
events.clip_query: Several vertical peels of the sphere turn yellow and pop out slightly
